kurz: Cook vegetables in steam above boiling water. They keep more flavour and nutrients than in water.
bild_im_kopf: Like a sauna instead of a bath: hot, but the vegetables are not washed out.
was_passiert: Steam transfers a lot of heat, because it gives off energy as it condenses on the cooler vegetables. Because the vegetables are not sitting in water, fewer aromas and vitamins leach out.
schritte: Bring a little water to the boil in a pot.
Put the vegetables in a steamer basket above it, lid on.
Choose pieces of equal size; 4–10 minutes depending on the variety.
Test with a knife, then serve straight away or refresh.
